Frequently Asked Questions

Why are developers looking for Postman alternatives?

Postman phased out its offline scratchpad, forcing users to create cloud accounts and upload workspaces to remote servers. APIFlow Studio provides a fast, offline-first alternative that works in your browser with zero account requirements.

Can I import my existing Postman collections?

Yes. Simply drag and drop your exported Postman Collection v2.1 JSON file into APIFlow Studio to import all your requests, parameters, and headers immediately.

Is APIFlow Studio free?

Yes, APIFlow Studio is 100% free with unlimited endpoints, mocks, and test assertions.
